download_to_file_path.description: The file path to download the receipt file to in file system app. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. If not passed, it will be saved in your ~/downloads directory.

file_system_access_token.description: Access token obtained from file_system app login.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists.

premium_subscription_id.description: ID of the premium subscription to download the receipt for.

workflow_definition.aggregation_logic: Specialist artifacts are relayed upward as reports; the orchestrator merges those reports into one artifact.
conditional_edges: dispatch_specialists -> specialist_worker (parallel Send fan-out) else relay_specialist_reports
workflow_definition.dispatch_logic: The orchestrator emits bounded task packages to the activated specialists.
stopping_criteria: Semantic no-progress across orchestrator merge artifacts
